Name: Victoria
Author: Connect29
Description: Was always a fan of gender switching the male bachelors to females. My only gripe is I wanted the portraits and sprites to match the vanilla style more. I'm not really that talented with pixel art so I searched online for a good base template. Original art design can be found at this post (https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/female-bachelors), but even then the creator based it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269?tab=images]talkohlooeys's art style[/url]. So idk who to give full credit for it; but I used the ones found there as a base template to create these sprite sheets. Person in the post is [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/members/jpsklr.16883/]jpsklr[/url].

Downloads.Description: Female Victor not much else to say.
